claims.meaning: Ordivon Runtime is a trusted-local execution subsystem that turns admitted operations into durable Jobs, owns process trees, preserves bounded evidence, and makes interruption and recovery explicit.
Runtime creates detached Git Workspaces bound to exact local revisions and provides guarded read, mutation, diff, and closure operations.
Each Attempt owns a systemd unit and cgroup process tree and records bounded Results, Artifacts, and supervision evidence.
After response loss, clients reconnect using the same request or discover and observe the same recorded Job instead of blindly creating a new opaque operation.
allowedWording: do not blindly repeat uncertain work

claims.meaning: Runtime does not own semantic Task completion, cognition, planning, hostile multi-tenant isolation, or domain proof of external-world effects.
avoid: secure execution of arbitrary untrusted agents
